get.description:
Returns tasks matching the supplied full-text or field filters. The
project ceiling is applied before pagination, so a scoped bearer token
never spends a page slot on an inaccessible match. `q` searches task
keys, titles, descriptions, project names, labels, board state,
priority, assignee/claim owner names, and bug details. When `q` is
supplied, matching projects and saved views are included in the
optional `projects` and `views` response fields for command navigation.
`view` loads a saved view first; explicit query parameters override its
matching filters without changing the saved view. `release_id` accepts
an opaque release ID or `unassigned`; global search never resolves a
bare release name because names can repeat across projects.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Match a task key such as OPS-42.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on task title.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on task description.

parameters.name: claim_owner
parameters.description: Match a claim owner ID or case-insensitive actor-name substring; use `none` for unclaimed tasks.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Restrict results to a project ID, key, or stable slug.

parameters.name: due_from
parameters.description: Include tasks due at or after this RFC3339 timestamp.

parameters.name: due_to
parameters.description: Include tasks due at or before this RFC3339 timestamp.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated stable sort terms such as `updated_at:desc,title:asc`.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Saved view ID to use as the initial filter set.

parameters.name: clear
parameters.description: Clear these saved criteria before applying explicit overrides, without changing the saved view or its project scope.
